author: profiler-agent

fund_id.rationale: No ticker/code column exists; scheme_name uniquely identifies each fund (789 distinct of 814 rows).

fund_name.rationale: scheme_name is the full display name of the fund.

fund_family.rationale: amc_name gives the asset management company operating the fund.

category.rationale: sub_category (38 distinct values like 'Sectoral / Thematic', 'Childrens Funds') matches a peer-group category granularity; the broader 'category' column is too coarse (only 5 values).

currency.rationale: File is Indian mutual fund data (AMC names, crore units), so currency is INR for all rows.

expense_ratio.rationale: Values (median 0.615, max 2.59) are typical Indian expense ratios expressed as percent, needing /100 to reach the 0-0.05 fraction range.

risk_score.rationale: risk_level ranges 1-6 and represents fund risk classification, rescaled to the 1-5 canonical scale.

return_1y.rationale: returns_1yr (median 4.4, range -19.7..130.8) is a percent trailing 1-year return, convert to fraction.

return_3y.rationale: returns_3yr (median 18.5) is annualised 3yr return in percent, convert to fraction.

return_5y.rationale: returns_5yr (median 8.9, 80% filled) is annualised 5yr return in percent, convert to fraction.

total_net_assets.rationale: fund_size_cr is fund size in Indian crore units, multiplier 1e7 converts to base currency units.

not_mapped: category_expense_ratio: no category-average expense ratio column provided
category_return_5y: no category-average 5yr return column provided
inception_date: only fund_age_yr (age in years) available, cannot derive an exact ISO launch date without inventing it
as_of_date: no column indicates the as-of/reporting date for the figures, cannot invent one
ticker: no exchange ticker symbol column exists for these mutual funds
